# Janaka Premathilaka

> Senior Java Engineer & Solution Architect, Zug, Switzerland. Banking-grade Java engineering, now bringing practical AI into regulated systems.

Every page linked here is plain HTML that reads without JavaScript. The same facts are available as JSON under /api/public/v1/ and as Schema.org JSON-LD in each page.

## Profile

- [Home](https://janaka.me/): 22+ years of banking-grade Java at UBS, Credit Suisse and the European Commission. Now bringing LLM, RAG and agentic AI into regulated systems. Zug.
- [CV](https://janaka.me/resume/): experience, certifications, education and stack, English and German

### Experience

- 01.2024 — present · Senior Full-Stack Solution Engineer (Lead), UBS / Cognizant (Zürich, Switzerland)
  - Full ownership of six enterprise applications through the Credit Suisse–UBS merger — system stability and zero operational interruptions under sustained pressure.
  - Led teams through multi-platform migrations and technology decommissioning, resolving high-priority production incidents with calm, decisive execution.
  - Led the application-archiving initiative to 100% on-time delivery under audit-grade deadlines; built Linux + Oracle CLI pipelines for multi-gigabyte regulated data feeds.
  - Designed and shipped LLM and agentic-RAG automations for internal banking workflows, integrated with existing Java services — including local Llama 3 inference for data that cannot leave the bank’s perimeter.
  - Hands-on with the OpenAI Agents SDK and Model Context Protocol (MCP): multi-tool orchestration, guardrails, and RAG-powered enterprise applications in Python.
  - Mentor junior engineers, lead code reviews, carry the on-call (Pikett) pager.
- 05.2019 — 01.2024 · IT Solution Developer, Credit Suisse / Cognizant (Zürich, Switzerland · remote from the UK 2019–2020)
  - 100% ownership of the mission-critical Master Data Management tool, built from scratch — the bank’s golden data source for search and reporting.
  - Architected and delivered three cloud-native applications end-to-end (Spring Boot, React, Oracle, microservices), including a web application for dynamic consumer endpoints and case-management tools with streaming integration.
  - Low-latency front-office FX trading platform (Java 11–17): ≈20% responsiveness gain through multithreading and memory tuning.
  - Built the team’s CI/CD, Kubernetes/Docker and observability pipelines; championed TDD with JUnit and Mockito.
- 01.2018 — 05.2019 · IT Solution Development Specialist, UBS / Cognizant (Zürich, Switzerland)
  - Modernised 20+ legacy components into Spring Boot microservices with robust solution architectures.
  - Automated Jenkins delivery pipelines; migrated the codebase from SVN to Git.
  - Strengthened testing with JUnit, integration tests and Cucumber BDD.
- 06.2011 — 01.2018 · Senior Full-Stack Java/JEE Developer, European Commission (DIGIT Division) (Brussels, Belgium)
  - Engineered and maintained the EU’s core e-procurement system — mission-critical, multi-language, public-sector — over a 6.5-year tenure; the system contributed about 40% of the department’s total revenue.
  - Distributed integration flows with Spring Integration; JBPM workflows for approvals, escalations and audit trails.
  - Full-stack delivery (Angular, Spring/Hibernate, EJB3, Oracle, WebLogic); release ownership and L3 production support.
- 05.2004 — 06.2011 · Senior Java/JEE Consultant & Engineer, Johnson & Johnson · Nokia Siemens · Union Bank of Colombo · and others (Belgium & Sri Lanka)
  - Core technical consultant across healthcare, telecom, banking and e-commerce — enterprise-grade Java/JEE solutions.
  - Union Bank of Colombo: core banking modules — loan system, lease schedules, cheque and passbook printing (EJB2, JSP, DB2 on AS/400).
  - Modernised architectures in Agile/Scrum settings; SOAP/REST integration; Oracle/MySQL optimisation.

## Projects and products

- [AssetCare](https://janaka.me/lab/assetcare/): A production-deployed Java 25, Spring Boot, Angular and Kubernetes application demonstrating modern full-stack, cloud-native and AI-assisted software engineering. Open source reference application, not for sale.
  - Live: https://assetcare.janaka.me/ · Source: https://github.com/Janaka2/spring-angular-production-blueprint
  - Stack: Java 25, Spring Boot 4.1, Angular 22, Keycloak, PostgreSQL 18, Liquibase, MinIO, K3s, Helm, Traefik, cert-manager, Terraform, GitHub Actions
  - Runs on one Hetzner CX33 created by Terraform; CI, security and release pipelines on GitHub Actions with signed multi-arch images.
  - The observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, OpenTelemetry) is an optional profile and is not running in production.
- [nüchtern](https://janaka.me/products/#nuechtern): Fasting companion that keeps the biology visible: phase timer, hydration, electrolytes. Offline, German and English. Open to acquisition or licensing.
  - Live: https://nuechtern.app/
- [Daily Momentum](https://janaka.me/products/#daily-momentum): A quiet record of where the day went: one tap says what you are doing, everything else is derived. On-device only. Open to acquisition or licensing.
  - Live: https://daily-momentum.com/
- [Loop](https://janaka.me/products/#loop): Remembers what repeats and learns the rhythm from your own history, on your device or your own Drive. Open to acquisition or licensing.
  - Live: https://loop.janaka.me/
- [BabyLoop](https://janaka.me/products/#babyloop): Two-tap care log for babies and toddlers, with a daily summary and a PDF for the paediatrician. On your device or your own Drive. Open to acquisition or licensing.
  - Live: https://babyloop.janaka.me/
- [LeftHere](https://janaka.me/products/#lefthere): Take a photo and it remembers where you left the car, keys, bag or a favourite place; the map walks you back. On your device or your own Drive. Open to acquisition or licensing.
  - Live: https://here.janaka.me/

## Blog

- [Blog](https://janaka.me/blog/): Clear, hands-on articles on Java, Kafka, RAG, agents and evals.
- [From Idea to Production: Building AssetCare with Java 25, Spring Boot, Angular, Kubernetes and AI](https://janaka.me/blog/posts/assetcare-idea-to-production.html): How a Java 25, Spring Boot 4.1 and Angular 22 application went from a prototype to a live Kubernetes deployment on Hetzner with Helm, Keycloak, PostgreSQL and Let's Encrypt, what broke on the way…
- [Dead-letter topics in Spring Kafka: retries and replay](https://janaka.me/blog/posts/spring-kafka-deadletter.html): How to handle poison pills in Spring Kafka with DefaultErrorHandler, @RetryableTopic, DeadLetterPublishingRecoverer and a governed replay path.
- [RAG with FAISS: Chunking, MMR and Re-Ranking](https://janaka.me/blog/posts/rag-faiss-patterns.html): Why naive top-k retrieval fails, how to chunk and index with FAISS, and how MMR and cross-encoder re-ranking fix it for a regulated bank.
- [Machine Learning: A Comprehensive Top-Down Guide](https://janaka.me/blog/posts/machine-learning-blog.html): A top-down introduction to machine learning: the workflow, the algorithms and the evaluation.
- [Evals — Designing and Interpreting AI Evaluation Frameworks](https://janaka.me/blog/posts/ai-evaluation-frameworks.html): Building and reading AI evaluation pipelines: metrics, tooling and agentic behaviour.
- [MCP for Agent Integrations: the Model Context Protocol](https://janaka.me/blog/posts/mcp-agent-integration.html): What the Model Context Protocol is, its three primitives and two transports, a minimal Python server, and how to run it safely in a regulated bank.
